thread:
alex m: Ran into a weird redwoodctl behavior after switching profiles. I ran `redwoodctl login --profile staging` then `redwoodctl whoami` and got:

error: failed to read config: missing active_profile

samir: what OS/version? arch?

alex m: macOS 13.6 on M1. `redwoodctl version` -> `redwoodctl v0.9.1 (darwin-arm64)`

alex m: here's my sanitized config:
```
$ cat ~/.redwood/config.json
{
  "profiles": { "default": {"token":"***"}, "staging": {"token":"***"} }
  // no active_profile key
}
```

jessica: that file is the pre-0.9.2 schema. We introduced an explicit `active_profile` field in v0.9.2. v0.9.1 won't set it automatically. You can either set env var `REDWOOD_PROFILE=staging` or run the config migration helper.

alex m: migrate helper? where is that documented?

jessica: `redwoodctl migrate-config --from v0.9.1` 14 it adds `active_profile` and fixes perms. Alternatively manually add `"active_profile": "staging"` at the top level of the json.

alex m: tried migrate, got `open ~/.redwood/config.json: permission denied` 14 I installed brew CLI earlier with `sudo` and my dotfiles look root-owned :facepalm: 

samir: common trap. Try `sudo chown -R $(whoami) ~/.redwood` then rerun the migrate. Also check if Homebrew on M1 put stuff in `/opt/homebrew` vs `/usr/local` 14 sometimes config ends up on a different path if you swapped brew installs.

alex m: chown fixed it. migrate ran and now `redwoodctl whoami` shows my email. thanks!

devops-bot: reminder - tokens from `redwoodctl login` expire after 12h by default. Use `redwoodctl login --refresh` or enable `session_auto_refresh` in the Console.

alex m: follow-up: when I run `redwoodctl local serve --profile staging` intermittently it fails with 401 because it used a cached token. Any local workaround?

samir: `redwoodctl login --profile staging --force` forces a fresh OIDC flow and replaces cached token. For CI/local noninteractive flows set `REDWOOD_TOKEN` env or use the service account flow.

alex m: `--force` fixed it. pushed a tiny fix to detect missing `active_profile` and auto-add it with a test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/pull/678

marco: nice. filing a small RFC to auto-migrate on startup with a one-time prompt + opt-out. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/issues/412

jessica: can you also add a note to the quickstart about `redwoodctl login --profile` vs `REDWOOD_PROFILE` env? We keep getting onboarding tickets from folks who think `--profile` persists across shells.

alex m: will add docs + a troubleshooting bullet about brew installs on mac arm vs intel (saves others an hour). closing thread after PR merges. :rocket:

marco: extra suggestion for DX: surface a clearer warning when config file is root-owned with a hint to `chown` in the CLI error message. saves a cycle.
